suite: leaders across the seam (synthetic anchors, the lit set, the selection triple, P2)
expect_red: [real] a re-lay of the DAG with a row selected leaves its leaders on its ends' dots and their anchors, both ways

mutations.contract: The overlay draws from the pane's current render, never a copy kept from an earlier one.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_leader_starts_at_the_mark_it_names_on_every_tier (2026-10-30). The stale-anchor shape itself: the dots kept from the first draw, so a re-lay moves the marks and not the leaders. (Dropping the paint hook alone is not seen: the scroll and resize redraws still read the fresh render.)
mutations.find:
var started = clock();
    var drawn = VA.lastTopoRender;
mutations.replace:
var started = clock();
    var drawn = VA.firstSeamRender || (VA.firstSeamRender = VA.lastTopoRender);
